facts.where: main table (ZeroShot / ZeroShot+Dynamic / ChatDify), block GLM-5.1
section 4.1 (Implementation Details)
facts.quote: All experiments use Dify v1.11.2 and LLM APIs from Volcengine (GLM-5.1), Deepseek-AI (DeepSeek-v4 pro) and Alibaba Cloud (Qwen-3.7 max), running on a 4-core Intel(R) Xeon(R) Platinum CPU server with 16 GB RAM.
facts.note: GLM-5.1 is served by the Volcengine API (a reseller, not the maker); effort not written

facts.value: We evaluate ChatDify on a curated benchmark of 100 production-inspired tasks
facts.where: abstract
facts.quote: We evaluate ChatDify on a curated benchmark of 100 production-inspired tasks across three state-of-the-art LLM backends, achieving 0.96, 0.91, and 0.75 success rates with Qwen-3.7, GLM-5.1, and DeepSeek-v4
facts.note: home-made benchmark of 100 Dify workflow-synthesis tasks; SR = success rate (a fraction); Dify v1.11.2
